title: Sequences, attention and transformers
summary: From sequence processing and the NLP pipeline to attention: queries, keys and values; scaled dot-product and multi-head attention as content-dependent linear maps; positional encoding; the transformer block; training transformers; BERT and GPT as pretraining recipes, cited as the tutorials present them.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is W2D5 Tutorial 2 (Natural Language Processing and LLMs) and W3D1 Tutorial 1 (Learn how to work with Transformers) of the Neuromatch Deep Learning ebook.

preparation.description: Read W3D1 Tutorial 1 (attention overview; queries, keys and values; multihead attention; transformer overview; positional encoding; training) and W2D5 Tutorial 2 (NLP architectures and pipeline, BERT, GPT).
